notes.title: Going Free To Play
notes.notes:
As of today, I made Fatal Velocity: Physics Combat a free to play game.

Why? (Some may be wondering)

I can no longer develop the game and feel that since I can't carry on any updates - people shouldn't be forced to pay to play the game.

There are still bugs and issues - but if you feel like killing some time with friends give it a go, swing around, knock some people off the map and enjoy.

[b]THANK YOU to those who supported me during the development (playtests and demos). If you picked up a copy - you have my sincerest thanks[/b]

Should I win the lottery I'd definitely pick up and continue the development xD 

Range.

notes.title: Steam Sale & What's Been Happening
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Wanted to mention that Fatal Velocity is currently 70% off during the Steam Sale! If you already have a copy let your pals know so you can throw 'em under a train or into some turbines!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30911027/3fbae75f8acd128ae27f5c78061ea518986ea927.png[/img]

[h1][u]What's Been Happening?[/u][/h1]

I want to keep everyone in the loop so they know where we've been and what's the future of Fatal Velocity.

(Where we've been)
- Dream Hack Austin 2018
- Positive feedback for the game & suggestions to improve
- Working on level design to standardize scale of maps and hazards
- Experimenting with weapon and gameplay design changes

(What's the future?)
- If new weapon and gameplay design changes work, expand upon original idea and keep growing the game's interest into the FPS genre
- Development will continue, but at a slower pace due to limited resources [b](1 developer working on this doesn't make it easy!)[/b]
- Community has shown some interest in tournaments [2 vs 2] or [3 vs 3]
- Explore the possibility of a solo exploration experience

If you haven't already, be sure to join our Discord for more community interaction! We're around 950 people and it would be f*cking AWESOME to hit 1,000 by July!!

notes.title: Back From PAX EAST 2018
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Finally back from PAX East 2018 and had a very good time. Definitely a learning experience and one where I walked away with my motivation recharged! I was constantly in awe of the cool games around me and meeting new people was absolutely awesome. Even with how crazy busy it was, I didn't want it to end. 

It was absolutely killer people would simply walk up start playing and just start trying to figure Fatal Velocity out. As it's not a typical FPS game I had to explain how to play and different methods of doing different things. All in all it was so great to get constructive feedback and I looked at the event like it was a 4 day playtesting session!

Here are my thoughts in the vlog, and I'll see you all later.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=shId-_Jup5Y&list=PL9dM6jWvLU4-wQewuRswNnCpv5TfXIDo4&index=17&t=0s
[b] Be sure to join our Discord to discuss development and progress with the community![/b]

notes.title: Fatal Velocity: Physics Combat Enters Early Access
notes.notes:
So here we are - the 5 year journey to get the game finally ready for Early Access is less than a few hours away. Long story short, the craziness of getting this game up and running since 2013 has been a dream of mine and to finally get here feels pretty badass, but journey is far from over. The game still has many improvements to enhance the experience and I'm looking forward to getting those underway after PAX East if the public interest allows it. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f_8F1RP4woM&t

I wanted to extend a massive thank you to everyone for helping me playtest the game - even if it was only once, doesn't matter. Your feedback at that time definitely helped me make the game what it is today. [b][u]I just wanted to announce that all players who helped playtest up to today will have the game for free - on me as a massive thank you.[/u][/b]

If you initially intended to buy a copy, please do me a favor and buy one for your friend. It'll be 30% off for the first little while, would help spread the word and get the game out to more people that don't know it exists.

Thank you again for your help and I hope to see you at one of playtests soon!

                                            [url=https://discord.gg/2wJqhP8][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30911027/31a6e811c3d81efb7b3b080bcb88e92ffd7b562f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: New Early Access Date!
notes.notes:
I have some major news to announce today. I have decided to officially launch Fatal Velocity: Physics Combat Early Access on March 27, 2018 instead of April 18, 2018. Heading to PAX in early April will not only allow players to try the game right then and there but buy a copy on the spot which is a huge opportunity to grow the community.

We’re going to work on polishing everything that is key to the gameplay experience such as tutorials, UI, networking and maps. Things like new maps and game modes will be temporarily halted until after PAX. 

I've also made a development vlog talking about recent accomplishments and upcoming plans to really polish the Early Access build! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JgvItWLL2Jg&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: First Tournament Summary
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, just wanted to make a quick follow up announcement congratulating the winners of the first 1 vs 1 FV tournament ever!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30911027/21b7f23c1cbc86e7eead90789cb6b6faa7501592.jpg[/img]

It was absolutely awesome to see players really try to gain the upper hand with their own play styles. Some choosing the complete mobility playstyle, others choosing a mixture of grappling and gravity or focusing on the mobility with ranged push orbs and grenades. Whatever their style was - each had pros and cons and it really shined here. 

Congrats to the winners again, and keep an eye out for the next tournament happening soon!

notes.title: Fatal Velocity Showing At C4 Winnipeg
notes.notes:
I will be straight the point. I've waiting to get to an event to show Fatal Velocity off for since the first week of development. To be at an event where hundreds, no... thousands of people can see the game is incredibly awesome. I love getting their honest opinions of the game face to face, seeing the excitement or enthusiasm they had on their faces as they played the game. The best part of it all though? The problems that I thought were problems, were of no concern to the playtester.

We spent about the first hour dusting ourselves off, getting into the groove of approaching people cold, but after a while - it simply came naturally. Getting people excited to be Spider-Man with Goku powers in a Smash Bros Environment, adding the discovery of pickups that help amp up their capabilities added to our confidence to really seek out as many people as possible. In fact, we had to ask a few people who had been playing for quite some time to come back because we needed to free up a computer to get new players in, there was a small line forming!

This is the second day and we've given out hundreds of cards, received over a hundred subscribers to our mailing list and the requests for the testing builds keep coming in. Honestly, the response exceeds what I expected to hear back. I thought people would enjoy it, but not actually stick around to such a point where parents had to drag their kids/teens off. It's awesome, I can't thank the playtesting community enough. They're the ones who have helped me make the game what it is today. So if anyone from the playtest sessions is reading this, you have my sincerest thanks.
